feats/craft-aboleth-glyph-446.name: Craft Aboleth Glyph
feats/craft-aboleth-glyph-446.effectSummary: Create a permanent glyph of warding effect that automatically reforms 1 minute after it is discharged or dispelled. Crafting takes 1 day per 1,000 gp of base price; base price is caster level × spell level × 1,000 gp. You pay 1/25 of base price in XP and half the base price in raw materials. feats/dreamtelling-759.name: Dreamtelling
feats/dreamtelling-759.effectSummary: Use Knowledge (the planes) to interpret dreams. Base DCs are 10 for obvious symbolism, 15 for unfamiliar cultural details, 20 for unfamiliar past-event memories, and 25 when both unfamiliar conditions apply; prophetic insight adds +10 to +20 depending on obscurity. Meeting the needed DC can provide augury-like information, exceeding it by 10 gives divination-like information, and by 20 gives commune-like information. Dreamscape injury consequences are DC 15 and identifying whether an item or place is native to a dream is DC 20. In dreamscapes, Knowledge (the planes) can replace Survival for navigation and tracking. Interpreting your own dream takes 30 minus your Intelligence modifier minutes; another person's detailed account adds 10+1d10 minutes. You get only one interpretation attempt per dream.
